items.title:
Who's giving this traditional Parkin bake a go? 👀

Ingredients

• 200g Deluxe butter, plus extra for greasing
• 225g golden syrup
• 85g dark brown sugar
• 250g self-raising flour
• 100g porridge oats
• 1 tbsp ground ginger
• 1 tsp mixed spice
• 1 large egg
• 60ml whole milk

Method

1. Preheat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Grease and line a 22cm square cake tin with baking paper.
2. Add the butter, golden syrup, and brown sugar to a large pan and cook over a gentle heat until melted together. Remove from the heat and allow to cool briefly.
3. In a bowl, mix together the oats, self-raising flour and spices.
4. Beat the egg and milk together in a small jug.
5. Stir the dry ingredients into the syrup mixture, then beat in the egg and milk until combined.
6. Pour the mixture into the prepared tin and bake for 50 minutes to 1 hour, until firm.
7. Leave to cool in the tin before cutting into squares and serving.

items.title: ✨Mac n Cheese with korean Chilli Chicken bites 🌶️  For the chicken: * 500g chicken * 1 tsp salt * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp black pepper * 1 tsp parsley * 1 tsp oregano * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp ginger & garlic paste Coating: * 1 egg * 150ml water * 1 cup flour * 1 tsp baking powder Sauce: * 4 tbsp butter * 4 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup ketchup * 1 cup sweet chilli sauce * 3 tbsp hot sauce * 2 tbsp sesame oil * 3 tbsp honey *2tbsp Buldak sauce or gochujang * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * ½ tsp chilli flakes Mac & Cheese * 300g pasta * 2 cups milk * 5 tbsp butter * 1 tbsp plain flour * ½ cup mozzarella or Red Leicester * 3 cheese slices * 1 tsp cayenne pepper * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 1 tsp parsley * 1 tsp oregano Method 1. Season chicken: Mix chicken with all the spices and ginger-garlic paste. Add egg, flour, baking powder and water. Mix until well coated. 2. Fry: Deep fry on medium heat until golden and crispy. Set aside. 3. Make sauce: Melt butter, sauté garlic, then add all sauce ingredients. Cook on low for 2 minutes. Add chicken and toss until coated. 4. Cook pasta: Boil pasta according to the packet instructions and drain. 5. Make cheese sauce: Melt butter with a little oil. Add flour and mix. Gradually add milk while stirring. Cook for 2–3 minutes. 6. Add cheese: Stir in both cheeses, cayenne, salt, pepper, parsley and oregano until smooth. Add a splash of milk if needed. 7. Combine: Add pasta and mix until creamy and well coated. 8. Serve: Top with chilli chicken and garnish with sesame seeds and spring onions. #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #macncheese #quickmeals #chicken

📊 Her husband attached a stool leg to a drill to treat a rugby injury. Five years later, they’d built an £8M-a-year sports recovery brand 🤯

We sat down with Lottie Whyte [@lottiewhyte] co-founder and CEO of MyoMaster @myomaster, to find out how a homemade massage gun turned into a multimillion-pound business.

In 2020, Lottie launched MyoMaster alongside her husband, former England rugby player Joe Gray, creating recovery products including massage guns, ice baths and saunas.
Their big breakthrough came in 2024 when Lottie appeared on Dragons’ Den, securing an investment offer before ultimately deciding to turn it down.

The exposure helped fuel huge demand, with MyoMaster going on to generate £8M in annual revenue.

In partnership with Monzo Business @monzo
